title: SIFMA-recommended US fixed-income early close, 2:00 p.m. ET — the last session before the Christmas closure, with equities open all day
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/guides-playbooks/holiday-schedule (SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 299,272 bytes). The 2027 panel is a hidden tab whose text the rendered page drops, so this session parsed it out of the page's own embedded payload, where each entry renders as three consecutive fields — heading, full-close date, early-close note. The US 2027 Christmas entry reads verbatim ['Christmas Day', 'Friday, December 24, 2027', 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Thursday, December 23, 2027']. The field shape reproduces across the same panel's other 2027 entries — ['Thanksgiving Day', 'Thursday, November 25, 2027', 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, November 26, 2027'] and ['Good Friday', 'Friday, March 26, 2027', 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Thursday, March 25, 2027'] — so the note attaches to the holiday it precedes, the same reading the sifma-bond-early-close-2027-03-25 entry already records off this identical page. The US panel is identified unambiguously by content rather than by heading: only it quotes Eastern Time, the UK panel's 2027 Christmas row reads ['Christmas Day', 'Friday, December 24, 2027', 'Boxing Day', 'None'] and the Japan panel's carries 'Tentative - Subject to confirmation by the Bank of Japan'. Filed estimate on three counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an industry trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and SIFMA's own recommendations are advisory to member firms rather than a market-wide halt. Discovered during the christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24 initial research (2026-09-08), where it is the load-bearing finding rather than an incidental one. This is one of only two dated sessions in the 2027 year-end corridor where the two asset classes keep DIFFERENT hours: equities trade a full session to 16:00 ET — NYSE's own early-close footnote, re-read direct from nyse.com the same session, names exactly ONE December early close across 2026/2027/2028 and it is 'Thursday, December 24, 2026', so there is no NYSE early close anywhere in December 2027 — while the recommended fixed-income tape shuts at 14:00 ET, two hours earlier. The following session, Friday 2027-12-24, is dark in equities, options (OCC marks it a hatched Exchange/OCC holiday) and fixed income alike. THE SIBLING ASYMMETRY, proposed in the same PR, is sifma-bond-early-close-2027-12-31; between them they are why the 2027 year-end week is not a 2024/2025 template with one day deleted. WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND EXECUTION: 2027-12-23 is the last price on the equity tape before a 3-non-trading-day gap, and the christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24 ledger measures that gap's own regularity (VIX close-to-close across a 3-day Christmas break: mean +4.32%, 16 of 20 positive since 1992) — so any study anchoring on the pre-break close is anchoring on a session whose bond-side reference disappeared two hours early. IMPACT LOW AND STRUCTURAL ONLY: a recommended early close is not a market-wide halt, it moves nothing by itself, and no house playbook is calendar- or holiday-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped for 'holiday|christmas|closure|half-day|early close' this session: zero hits in both). HONEST LIMIT ON THE KIND FIELD: EventKind (src/domain/market-events-types.ts) has no market-structure member, so this is filed 'rates', the same imperfect fit and the same reasoning the sifma-bond-early-close-2027-03-25 entry records. SECOND HONEST LIMIT: whether CME's rate futures keep separate hours that afternoon is NOT asserted — no CME source was fetched this session. Proposed as an estimate; an estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
